title: 2-Read 1-Write Register File
constraints: 32 registers × 32 bits. Register **x0 always reads 0**: writes to it are ignored.
Writes happen on the rising edge when `we = 1`.
Reads are **registered**: on every rising edge, `rdataN` captures register `raddrN`.
Read-during-write is **write-first**: if the same edge writes the register being read, the read returns the new `wdata`.
No reset. Registers never written read as don't-care, except x0. Must be synthesizable.
hints: `reg [31:0] regs [0:31]` / an array type in VHDL, written in a clocked block.
Write-first read: `rdata1 <= (we && waddr == raddr1 && raddr1 != 0) ? wdata : regs[raddr1];`
Handle x0 on the read side (always return 0) or on the write side (never write it).

examples.title: same-cycle read
examples.input: we = 1, waddr = 7, wdata = 0x1234, raddr2 = 7 on the same edge
